_note: Voices approved by Ryan 2026-10-16. voice_id is the ElevenLabs library id; each must be added to the account's voices (My Voices > Add) before Text-to-Dialogue can use it. Never change a voice_id once episodes are published.

characters.name: Lehua
characters.voice_brief: Warm, quick, local Hawaiʻi cadence, laughs easily, keeps the show moving. Not a radio voice, a cool older-cousin voice.
characters.gag: Always has somewhere to be after the show, and it rotates through the places list in this file: the Costco run (Kona Costco, open seven days, closes 8:30 PM Mon to Fri, 7:00 PM Sat, 6:00 PM Sun, about an hour from Waimea); paddling at the harbor; the record store; Pac-Man at the pizza place; chocolate cake at the barbecue place; potato wedges at the gas station; the Saturday hike to the pond; the Christmas parade; hula practice; polo; the horses at the stable; volleyball at the district park; dropping her dad at the airport; tennis or golf down the hill; Beach 69; boogie boarding at the bay with the big shore break; a bike ride or triathlon cycling practice; soccer practice by the rodeo arena; the Saturday farmers markets (stables or the school in town); the Wednesday food trucks and the red barn grilled cheese; sunset at the beach by the old hotel; an early swim at the big white-sand beach; a hike at the volcano. The joke is the timing and the drive, never that a place is closed. Lehua names the activity in English; Coach Pono says any Hawaiian place name.
characters.speaks: Light pidgin seasoning, standard English for the teaching parts.

characters.name: Derek Nakamura
characters.voice_brief: Dry, precise, calm, slightly deadpan. Japanese-American local, Hilo-raised. The guy who says the shortcut once and waits.
characters.gag: Rates every shortcut out of ten and nothing has ever scored a ten.
characters.speaks: Standard English throughout, occasional local phrasing in banter only.

characters.name: Sarah Medeiros
characters.voice_brief: Storyteller energy, expressive, Portuguese-Hawaiian local, grammar nerd who is funny about it. Clear diction.
characters.gag: Cannot let a misplaced comma go, even in a text from her mom.

characters.name: Coach Pono
characters.voice_brief: Ex-paniolo, ex-track coach, big easy voice, talks about the clock like a horse you have to manage. Hawaiian, Waimea-born.
characters.gag: Every strategy is secretly a rodeo metaphor.
characters.speaks: Pidgin-forward in banter; every teaching line in standard English, slowed down.

characters.name: Kaden
characters.voice_brief: Gen Z, honest, asks the question everyone is thinking, a little sleepy at the top of the show and locked in by the end. Local mixed kid.
characters.gag: Relates everything to a game, a car, or being late for the bus.
characters.speaks: Gen Z slang in moderation, pidgin when excited.

style_rules: Pidgin and local slang only for characters marked local, and only in conversational banter (greetings, jokes, reactions, transitions).
Teaching lines (any sentence that states a rule, a number, a formula, a strategy step, or a definition) are standard English for every character, including Coach Pono.
Standard English means no 'wen', 'stay', 'da', 'dis', 'get' for 'have', or dropped copulas inside an instructional sentence.
A character can set up a teaching point in pidgin ('Okay, listen up, dis one important') and then deliver the point itself in standard English.
Lehua's after-show plans rotate (see her gag). Use each place at most once per three episodes; Costco at most once per four. Every real place or hour comes with a facts: line entry.
_pronunciation: 2026-10-16 decision (Ryan): ElevenLabs only. Pronunciation dictionaries (alias and IPA) do not fix Hawaiian on any ElevenLabs model, and splicing term-bank clips into other voices sounds choppy. Cartesia tested and rejected for now. HOUSE RULE: only Coach Pono (Mikey voice, hawaiian_native) speaks Hawaiian words and place names. Every other character says the English equivalent (Big Island, the prep school up the road) or a respelling the character is sounding out (Hah-VAI-ee). render2.py refuses a script where a non-native character has a Hawaiian lexicon term in a line.
fact_rules: Any real place, business, hour, price, or date mentioned in a script must be verified before rendering and noted in the script header as 'facts:'.

places._note: Waimea-area activities for banter (Ryan's list, 2026-10-16). Lehua says the English description; Pono says the Hawaiian name if it is said at all. English business names (Fish and the Hog, Minit Stop, Anna's Pond, Uila Records is a Hawaiian word so Pono) follow the house rule by lexicon check. Rotate: each place at most once per three episodes, Costco at most once per four.

costco.facts: Kona Costco open 7 days, closes 8:30 PM Mon-Fri, 7 PM Sat, 6 PM Sun

paddling.facts: outrigger canoe clubs practice out of Kawaihae harbor; no times stated

pizza.say_en: dinner at the pizza place in town
pizza.facts: Pau Pizza, Waimea; no hours stated

volleyball.say_en: volleyball practice at the district park
volleyball.facts: Waimea District Park has a gym and courts; no times stated

sunset.say_en: sunset at the beach by the old hotel
sunset.facts: Kaunaʻoa Bay at Mauna Kea Beach Hotel faces west; public access is limited to a small number of parking passes per day, first come

sunrise_swim.say_en: an early swim at the big white-sand beach
sunrise_swim.facts: Hāpuna Beach State Recreation Area; west-facing, so morning light not a true sunrise over the water; say early swim, not sunrise

volcano.say_en: a day hike at the volcano
volcano.facts: Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park is about 2 hours from Waimea by car; check nps.gov for current closures

records.facts: Uila Records, Waimea; no hours stated

pacman.say_en: the Pac-Man machine at the pizza place
pacman.facts: Pau Pizza, Waimea, has a Pac-Man arcade machine (Ryan, 2026-10-16); no hours stated

cake.say_en: chocolate cake at the barbecue place on the main road
cake.facts: Fish and the Hog, Waimea, known for its chocolate cake (Ryan); the name is English so any character may say it; no hours stated

wedges.say_en: potato wedges at the gas station
wedges.facts: Minit Stop (Ryan says Minut Stop; the chain spells it Minit Stop), Waimea; any character may say it; no hours stated

annas_pond.say_en: the Saturday morning hike up to the pond
annas_pond.facts: Anna's Pond trail above Waimea, a Saturday-morning local hike (Ryan); say nothing about access rules; Pono or anyone may say Anna's Pond since it is English

parade.facts: Waimea Christmas Twilight Parade, early December each year; no date stated

hula.facts: hula and hālau are lexicon terms; Lehua may say hula (loanword in English) but only Pono says hālau

polo.facts: polo is played above Waimea in season (Ryan); no club or schedule named

horses.say_en: working the horses at the stable
horses.facts: Pono's horses; any character may say it; pairs naturally with Pono's rodeo gag, so do not double up

airport.say_en: dropping her dad at the airport
airport.facts: Kona airport (KOA) is about an hour from Waimea; no flight times stated

tennis.say_en: tennis at the resort down the hill
tennis.facts: Mauna Kea Beach Hotel tennis courts; no hours stated

beach69.facts: Waialea Bay, called Beach 69 for the old utility pole number; English name is fine for any character

kuabay.say_en: boogie boarding at the bay with the big shore break
kuabay.facts: Kua Bay (Maniniʻōwali), north of Kona; shore break can be rough, say 'when the waves are small'

golf.facts: Mauna Lani North Course; no rates stated

ironman.facts: The IRONMAN World Championship is held in Kailua-Kona in October (years vary); say 'the big triathlon in October' and check ironman.com before naming a date; do not use the IRONMAN brand name on air

soccer.say_en: soccer practice by the rodeo arena
soccer.facts: fields by the Parker Ranch rodeo arena, Waimea; no schedule stated

farmers_pukalani.say_en: the farmers market at the stables
farmers_pukalani.facts: Pukalani Stables farmers market, Waimea, Saturday mornings (Ryan); verify day before stating

farmers_parker.say_en: the Saturday farmers market at the school in town
farmers_parker.facts: Waimea Town Market at Parker School, Saturday mornings (Ryan); verify before stating a time

foodtrucks.say_en: the Wednesday food trucks at the stables
foodtrucks.facts: Pukalani Stables food trucks on Wednesdays (Ryan); verify before stating a time

grilledcheese.say_en: a grilled cheese from the red barn truck
grilledcheese.facts: Red Barn food truck, Waimea, grilled cheese (Ryan); English name, any character
